description: Wildlife video clips for the repeatable Guardian video test (scripts/guardian/video_eval.py). Fixed trail cameras, day and night (infrared). Downloaded by scripts/guardian/fetch_wildlife_videos.py into data/guardian/videos/ (git-ignored); never redistributed. Licence and author are checked against the Wikimedia Commons API at download time, and the file against Commons' SHA-1. `present_s` / `absent_s` are time ranges (seconds) labelled by eye from 1-2 fps contact sheets on 2026-10-16; frames outside both are not scored. `expected` names what SpeciesNet should confirm (null: not a Guardian target or no animal).
